title: weaver settings
description: Weaver-wide preferences, the same for every project. See https://github.com/medilies/weaver/blob/main/docs/settings.md

selected-colour.description: The colour marking what is selected in the browser, the config form and the questions weave asks: an ANSI colour number, 0-255, or "#rrggbb". Cyan (6) unless set.

preview.description: Whether the browser shows the preview of a running session's window, rather than its drawing, until p switches. true unless set.

preview-every.description: How often the browser reads the preview, which projects there are and which run, and the selected project again: a duration from "100ms" to "1m", such as "500ms" or "2s". "1s" unless set.

miniatures.description: Whether the browser's window list draws each window small under its name, when there are lines to spare. true unless set.

mouse.description: Whether the browser, the config form and the questions weave asks take clicks. Off, the terminal selects text again. true unless set.

editor.description: The editor E opens a config in, written as $VISUAL is, such as "code --wait": the config's path is added after it. $VISUAL, else $EDITOR, else vi unless set.

tmux-timeout.description: How long weave waits on a tmux command before giving up: a duration from "500ms" to "1m", such as "10s". "5s" unless set.

popup.description: Whether the browser (weave) and the config form (weave bind), started in a tmux pane, re-run themselves in a tmux popup the size of the client. false unless set.

keys.description: The keys of the browser's and the config form's actions, one key each, their own unless set. Moving, enter, esc, Tab and ctrl+c stay fixed. In the config form, o, d, h/j/k/l, y and n stay fixed too. Two actions available at once can't share a key: the config form's, drawing keys included, the browser's project list's, or its task list's.

split-right.description: Split the selected pane, the new one on the right. % unless set.

split-below.description: Split the selected pane, the new one below. " unless set.

remove.description: Remove the selected pane. x unless set.

shrink.description: Make the selected pane smaller. H unless set.

grow.description: Make the selected pane larger. L unless set.

start.description: Browser: start the selected project, staying. s unless set.

bind.description: Browser: bind the current directory. b unless set.

edit.description: Browser: change the selected project's config in the config form. e unless set.

edit-raw.description: Browser: edit the selected project's config raw in the editor. E unless set.

kill.description: Browser: kill the selected project's session. x unless set.

delete.description: Browser: delete the selected project's config. d unless set.

rerun.description: Browser: rerun the selected pane's exited command. r unless set.

reload.description: Browser: reload the selected pane or its window. R unless set.

preview.description: Browser: switch between the preview and the drawing. p unless set.

config.description: Browser: show the config instead of the drawing. y unless set.

tasks.description: Browser: move the cursor into the task list. t unless set.

filter.description: Browser: filter the projects by name. / unless set.

run.description: Browser's task list: run the selected task, staying. r unless set.

throwaway.description: Browser's task list: run the selected task in a throwaway window. w unless set.

interrupt.description: Browser: interrupt the selected pane, or the selected task in the task list. i unless set.

undo.description: Config form: undo the last change. u unless set.

redo.description: Config form: redo what was undone. ctrl+r unless set.

save.description: Config form: save, after showing the diff. ctrl+s unless set.

move-up.description: Config form: move the item, task or window the cursor is on up. K unless set.

move-down.description: Config form: move the item, task or window the cursor is on down. J unless set.

key.description: A key as the terminal sends it: a character such as | or -, or a name such as space, f5, ctrl+x or alt+s.
